style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, bright sunlit interior
character: glossy brown bark beetle, business collar and loose tie, six legs, heavy mandibles, tired eyes, fills two thirds of frame
props: paper glued to his back reading КРЕДИТ in big capitals; two collector mites riding him, one with a ledger strip, one with a stamp - their place is his back and shoulders, never the tunnel floor, until 8.2; flying chips, lit amber resin
prop_continuity: КРЕДИТ paper on his back all ten seconds; sawdust streams off his mandibles every window
motion_rule: every window he drives forward up the tunnel toward the sunlit gap, gnawing and shouldering through wood, never sitting; he wrenches, kicks and shakes at the mites and they keep their grip; new shot size every window, camera always moving
environment: a tunnel bored through honey-coloured wood, hard midday sun blazing through the gap far ahead, sawdust glittering gold in the beam; the wood glows warm and bright end to end

audio.delivery: flat tired male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: o-DEEN, DU-mal, pro-gry-ZU, SVE-tu, te-PER, gry-ZU, u-ZHE, u-VE-ren, E-to, LES
audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 8.2
audio.lip_sync: the beetle talks like a person, jaw and mandibles open and close clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: wood grinding, chips cracking, stamp thud

timeline.a: his mandibles rip a chunk out of the wood at the lens, sawdust bursting into the sunbeam
timeline.c: big close on mandibles, push in

timeline.a: he drives at the lens up the tunnel, the stamp mite slamming the stamp on his back
he rams his head into the wall, a slab of wood cracks off and flies at the lens
he barrels up the tunnel toward the sunlit gap, both mites riding his back
still charging, he lifts his head into the beam of sun
he wrenches his shoulders, the ledger mite swinging out sideways on one claw, still hooked in his back
he grinds forward through the wood, chips streaming past the lens
he throws his body sideways, grinding the stamp mite along the wall, resin spraying, claws still hooked in him
he grinds on toward the light, the ledger mite unrolling a ledger strip across his eyes
he bursts head first out through the gap into the blazing light
timeline.c: tight inside the hole to low frontal outside

timeline.a: he hauls himself onto the plank end, both mites leaping off onto the next plank
the camera keeps pulling out - he stands on the end of one sawn plank in a stacked timber pile, an identical hole in every plank, an identical beetle heaving out of each with the same КРЕДИТ paper
timeline.c: pull back to low wide, the stack filling frame

must_appear: the ledger strip across his eyes at 5.4; the breakout at 7.0; the stack of identical planks, beetles and КРЕДИТ papers at 9.0
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, garbled or misspelled words, any lettering other than КРЕДИТ, Latin letters on the paper, a static camera, a static wide, he stands still while speaking, a mite on the tunnel floor before 8.2, a mite doing nothing before 8.2, a gap between beetle and mites before 8.2, the КРЕДИТ paper coming off, props hovering motionless in mid-air, more or fewer than six legs, English speech, any word after 8.2
